verdict.rationale: VPM's own docs say it acts as registered agent, receiving service of process and state correspondence, and that this is 'Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans'. That ties the service directly to the mailbox plan, and the docs add same-day scanning, real-time email alerts and cloud PDF storage of served documents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of which states are covered and how the service appears within a single account.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get registered agent service tied to the same account — service-of-process handling bundled with or added to my mailbox plan

citations.quote: As your registered agent, VPM will receive service of process, legal notices, and other important state correspondences on your behalf. ... Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans.
All legal documents served are scanned and available online the same day they are received so you have more time to respond.
All forwarded documents are scanned and stored as PDF files on the cloud.
